# Silly Travel Tool — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org

> Silly Travel Tool is a travel planner that turns booking emails into one itinerary per trip, with the weather for your dates.

## What it does
- Imports bookings from confirmation emails: forward one and it lands in the right trip
- Keeps one itinerary per trip, day by day, in each place's local time
- Shows the weather for your trip dates
- City guides for destinations worldwide
- Currency conversion and emergency SOS numbers by country
- Stores travel documents

## URL
https://sillytraveltool.com

## More
- Guide and FAQ: https://sillytraveltool.com/help/
